entities.summary: Ilya Sergeyevich Solaryov also known as Ilya Solarev is a Kazakhstani former professional ice hockey winger. He played for Barys Astana of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was selected by the Tampa Bay Lightning in the 9th round of the 2001 NHL Entry Draft.
